htm-preact-standalone.mjs = htm 3.1.1 `preact/standalone.module.js` (unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1),
which bundles htm (Apache-2.0, LICENSE-htm.txt) and Preact 10 (MIT, LICENSE-preact.txt).
Vendored unmodified; served from the daemon binary.
uPlot.iife.min.js + uPlot.min.css = uPlot 1.6.31 (unpkg.com/uplot@1.6.31/dist), MIT (LICENSE-uplot.txt).
Loaded as a classic script that defines window.uPlot. Vendored unmodified.

by Google Fonts (fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20). SIL Open Font License 1.1 (inter/LICENSE-inter.txt).
